The Company has maintained requisite asset cover as per offer documents by way of pari passu floating charge on current assets, book debts and loans & advances of the Company and/or pari passu charge through equitable mortgage of Company's and third parties' immovable properties and guarantee for its Secured Listed Non-Convertible Debentures of aggregating amount of Rs. 137.75 Crores as at March 31, 2024.
